_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Ati Kubbaa {player_id} Tic Tac Toe keessa jirta.
Gaalii kee kuusaa sadii sirnaan (bantii, oliifi, ykn viidiyaa) boordii irratti mo'achuudha.
Gidduu kee, kuusaa nambarii (0-8) ittiin kubbayyuu kee boordii irratti maxxansuuf filachuu qabda.
Fkn, '[4]' kubbayyuu kee boordii gidduu maxxansa.
Kubbaa {player_id} ta'uu kee, ati '{symbol}' ta'a, diinni kee '{opponent_symbol}' ta'a.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tarkaanfiin dhiyaate bifa sirrii hin hordofne.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} seeliin sirrii miti. 0 fi 8 gidduutti ta'uu qaba.
